author: Veto platform team (reference)
description: A read-only daily digest of watched roles and application stages. Drafts a local summary and queues a notification proposal — it never sends, submits, or messages anyone.
name: Role Radar Digest

actions.description: Read-only snapshot: counts of watched roles and tracked applications.
Draft the digest as a local markdown artifact. Nothing leaves the device.
Queue a notification proposal in the host center. The extension cannot send.
